title: test(cli): keep the two-namespace control's tools distinct so the bare-name rule does not judge it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Ff4UJdxHJzwSQG7VEko8ou)_

Prerequisite for #31661 (it was ejected from the merge queue by this test, queue build 42539489585, Test Core 1/8, triage 6729558102). Test-only; no card of its own, so `skip-changeset`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改 `packages/cli/test/validate-namespace-name.test.ts` 的夹具：两个命名空间那条 CONTROL 里，beta 包的 tool 从 `nsn_lookup` 改名为 `nsn_other_lookup`;同命名空间那几条仍共用 `tool/nsn_lookup`。
- 为什么改:#31661 让一期 bare-name 规则在封存后按全环境拒绝同名 tool,于是这个"两个命名空间可以同名"的 CONTROL 在 premise 用例里被 `BareNameConflictError` 422 拒掉。它本意只测 #31717 的命名空间规则，不该被 bare-name 规则判。
- 风险与回滚：只动测试夹具和一个用例标题，不改产品代码。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packagesStack` 的 `betaTool` 一行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/validate-namespace-name.test.ts` —— 预期 4 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地后 #31661 可重新入队。

## What changes

- `packagesStack(betaNs)` gives the beta package's tool its own name when `betaNs` is not `nsn` (`nsn_other_lookup`), so the two-namespace CONTROL shares only the page `nsn_home`. The shared-namespace fixtures still hold `page/nsn_home` and `tool/nsn_lookup` twice, so every refusal assertion is unchanged. The CONTROL's title now says what it holds ("the same page name in two namespaces validates"). A doc comment says why: a tool is also phase 1's bare-name one-holder type, judged environment-wide, so a shared tool across two namespaces is that rule's refusal, not this rule's CONTROL. `os validate` does not run the bare-name rule, so the CLI CONTROL reads the same either way; only the package-door premise is affected.

## Verification

Every run under `os-verify-lock`, CLI closure rebuilt each time:

- This head `86e164c2` (main `cae8d8fe` + this commit): `test/validate-namespace-name.test.ts` **4 passed**.
- This head merged with #31661's head `30b6c84f` (scratch branch): **4 passed**.
- `main` merged with #31661 (no fix, scratch branch): **1 failed / 3 passed**, the premise: `expected BareNameConflictError: Bare-name conflict… to be undefined`. That is the queue failure, reproduced, and the fix clears it.
- Lint: `eslint packages/cli/test/validate-namespace-name.test.ts --no-inline-config` exit 0. Gates: `dispatch-gates --ran` on `86e164c2`: **49 derived, 49 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED**, all exit 0 (`check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first read a declaration-less / partial local build and were re-run green after a full closure build).
